repair.problem: Legitimate frozen baseline movement can be discovered late inside DevSystem, producing cascading failures and repeated head-specific thaw pressure.
repair.root_cause: The Step-6 lifecycle can safely plan a baseline forward-port, but no preflight layer proves that every live mismatch corresponds to an exact thaw that has actually merged since the registry's prior source-main.
repair.patch: Add a read-only auto-reconciliation planner that detects frozen drift early, authorizes only newly merged exact-thaw transitions, atomically advances every frozen owner through the proven Step-6 lifecycle, retires obsolete thaw pairs, preserves unrelated grants, and permits one retry only after state_hash advances.
